name: DecayCard-TS-TW
blurb: Image distorts and displaces as you move the cursor, stronger when you move faster.
description: Renders an image with SVG turbulence and displacement filters that responds to cursor movement and velocity. The image translates and rotates slightly, with displacement intensity mapped to cursor speed.
use_when: A featured image needs interactive visual feedback that rewards exploration and movement.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces or performance-critical contexts — runs a continuous RAF loop even when idle.
a11y: Cursor-tracking wrapper only; keyboard and touch users cannot trigger the effect, and there's no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
